reason: I already take Toplux and reorder it when it runs out, and it costs less than this. I have no reason to switch a routine that works.
objection: $29.99 is more than Toplux at $23 or Goli at $19, and those last longer. I don't see what I get for the extra money.
would_change_my_mind: A price at or below what I pay for Toplux, or a free trial box so I can compare it myself without spending more.
